==English==
{{was wotd|2016|January|20}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɹəʊv/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-rove.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹoʊv/|a=GenAm}}
* {{rhymes|en|əʊv|s=1}}

===Etymology 1===
Probably from {{inh|en|enm|*roven}}, a Midlands variant of Northern {{inh|en|enm|raven||to wander}}, from {{der|en|non|ráfa||to rove; stray about}}. Cognate with {{cog|is|ráfa||to wander}}, {{cog|sco|rave||to wander; stray; roam}}.

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|obsolete|intransitive}} To [[shoot]] with arrows (at).
#* {{RQ:Spenser Faerie Queene|1|3|passage=And thou {{...}} that with thy cruell dart / At that good knight so cunningly didst '''roue''' {{...}}}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[roam]], or [[wander]] [[about]] at [[random]], especially over a [[wide]] [[area]].
#* {{RQ:Burroughs Tarzan of the Apes|1|passage=Now that he was in his prime, there was no simian in all the mighty forest through which he '''roved''' that dared contest his right to rule, nor did the other and larger animals molest him.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To roam or wander through.
#* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=8|passage='''Roving''' the field, I chanced / A goodly tree far distant to behold.|year=1873}}
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=1832
|first=Charles
|last=Lyell
|authorlink=Charles Lyell
|chapter=VI
|title=[[w:Principles of Geology|Principles of Geology: Being an Attempt to Explain the Former Changes of the Earth's Surface, by Reference to Causes Now in Operation]]
|volume=II
|volumeurl=https://archive.org/details/PrinciplesgeoloVol2Lyel/
|location=London
|publisher=[[w:John Murray (publishing house)|John Murray]]
|OCLC=934484843
|page=94
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/PrinciplesgeoloVol2Lyel/page/94/
|text=The rein-deer, which in Scandinavia can scarcely exist to the south of the sixty-fifth parallel, descends, in consequence of the greater coldness of the climate, to the fiftieth degree, in Chinese Tartary, and often '''roves''' into a country of more southern latitude than any part of England.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[card]] [[wool]] or other [[fibre]]s.
# To [[twist]] slightly; to bring together, as slivers of wool or cotton, and twist slightly before spinning.
# To [[draw]] through an [[eye]] or [[aperture]].
# To [[plough]] into [[ridge]]s by turning the [[earth]] of two [[furrow]]s together.
# To practise [[robbery]] on the seas; to [[voyage]] about on the seas as a [[pirate]].
#* {{RQ:Hakluyt Principall Navigations|passage= pirates, '''roving''' up and downe the sea}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# A [[copper]] [[washer]] upon which the end of a nail is [[clinch]]ed in [[boatbuilding]].
# A [[roll]] or [[sliver]] of [[wool]] or [[cotton]] drawn out and lightly twisted, preparatory to further processing; a [[roving]].
# The act of wandering; a ramble.
#* {{RQ:Young Night-Thoughts|318|In thy nocturnal '''rove''' one moment halt.}}
